image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a meal setup. The primary subject is a black cast-iron skillet (frying pan) in the foreground containing cooked food (appears to be scrambled eggs or potatoes with banana slices). To the left is a white bowl containing sliced carrots and other vegetables. The background includes a wooden surface.
